title: X-Frame-Options header missing
description: The response sets no X-Frame-Options header, so the page can be framed by any site, which enables clickjacking: attacker UI overlaid on real authenticated actions.
remediation: Send X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN for intentional framing) on every HTML response. Prefer CSP frame-ancestors as the modern equivalent and keep both during migration.
limitation: Header presence only: the value is not validated, so ALLOW-FROM quirks and meta-tag equivalents are out of scope.
